ALTER TABLE course_plan_request
    ADD COLUMN path_command_kind varchar(16),
    ADD COLUMN path_command_expected_version bigint,
    ADD COLUMN path_command_hash char(64),
    ADD COLUMN path_command_payload jsonb,
    ADD COLUMN path_command_checkpointed_at timestamptz,
    ADD COLUMN path_command_result_code varchar(64),
    ADD COLUMN path_command_course_id uuid,
    ADD COLUMN path_command_reused boolean,
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_all_or_none CHECK (
        (path_command_kind IS NULL
            AND path_command_expected_version IS NULL
            AND path_command_hash IS NULL
            AND path_command_payload IS NULL
            AND path_command_checkpointed_at IS NULL
            AND path_command_result_code IS NULL
            AND path_command_course_id IS NULL
            AND path_command_reused IS NULL)
        OR
        (path_command_kind IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_expected_version IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_hash IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_payload IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_checkpointed_at IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_result_code IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_reused IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_kind CHECK (
        path_command_kind IS NULL OR path_command_kind IN ('REPLAN', 'NO_GAP')
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_expected_version CHECK (
        path_command_expected_version IS NULL OR path_command_expected_version >= 1
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_hash CHECK (
        path_command_hash IS NULL OR path_command_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_payload CHECK (
        path_command_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(path_command_payload) = 'object'
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_path CHECK (
        path_command_kind IS NULL OR learning_path_id IS NOT NULL
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_course_plan_path_command_outcome CHECK (
        path_command_kind IS NULL
        OR (path_command_kind = 'REPLAN'
            AND path_command_result_code IN ('COURSE_CREATED', 'COURSE_REUSED')
            AND path_command_course_id IS NOT NULL
            AND path_command_reused = (path_command_result_code = 'COURSE_REUSED'))
        OR (path_command_kind = 'NO_GAP'
            AND path_command_result_code = 'NO_GAP'
            AND path_command_course_id IS NULL
            AND path_command_reused = false)
    );

COMMENT ON COLUMN course_plan_request.path_command_payload IS
    'Immutable exact Student path-command body retained across retries and terminal audit';

COMMENT ON COLUMN course_plan_request.path_command_result_code IS
    'Private planned terminal outcome; copied to public result columns only after confirmed Student success';
